## Summary

Wrote `tests/org/apache/commons/lang3/time/DateUtilsAgentTest.java` — a self-contained JUnit 4 test class (matching the `junit-4.12` / `junit-4.7` jars in `lib/`), `-source 8` clean (no diamond, lambdas, underscores, or try-with-resources).

### Design
- Forces default `TimeZone` to GMT and `Locale` to English in `@Before`, restores in `@After`, so day/hour arithmetic has no DST discontinuities and parsing is deterministic. All fixtures (`cal`, `date`, `assertFields`, `drain`, `containsYmd`) are private helpers inside the file.
- Every assertion is traceable to the javadoc in `api/` (worked examples, "Throws" clauses, and the class-level "Math.floor/ceil/round versions for dates" contract).

### Coverage (≈70 test methods)
| Area | What's checked |
|---|---|
| Constants / ctor | exact values of `MILLIS_PER_*`, `MODIFY_*`, `RANGE_*`, `SEMI_MONTH`; `UTC_TIME_ZONE` has zero offset & no DST; public ctor usable |
| `add*` | value + exact millisecond delta, negative/zero amounts, original not mutated, new object, null → `IllegalArgumentException` |
| `set*` | target field changed, others preserved, hour boundaries 0/23, null → IAE |
| `toCalendar` | equal instant; null → `NullPointerException` (distinct from IAE) |
| `round` / `truncate` / `ceiling` | javadoc examples for HOUR/DAY/MONTH, `SEMI_MONTH` first half, Calendar overload returns a *different* object & leaves original untouched, `Object` overload accepts Date+Calendar, non-Date/Calendar → `ClassCastException`, null → IAE, floor ≤ value ≤ ceiling invariant |
| `isSameDay` / `isSameInstant` / `isSameLocalTime` | same-day-different-time true, different day/year false, same instant across zones (instant true / local-time false), field-difference detection, null → IAE |
| `parseDate` / `parseDateStrictly` | single & multi-pattern, whole-string requirement, no-match & no-patterns → `ParseException`, lenient rollover vs strict rejection, null args → IAE |
| `iterator` | the javadoc `RANGE_MONTH_SUNDAY` example verbatim (35 days, Jun 30 Sun → Aug 3 Sat, 1-day spacing), all week/month range styles, Calendar focus, invalid style → IAE, null → IAE, non-Date/Calendar → CCE, `remove()` → `UnsupportedOperationException` |
| `getFragmentIn*` | documented example values for ms/s/min/hours/days (Date + Calendar), "fragment ≤ unit ⇒ 0" boundaries, null → IAE, unsupported fragment → IAE |
| `truncatedEquals` / `truncatedCompareTo` | equality/sign across SECOND/MILLISECOND/MONTH/YEAR fields, Date + Calendar, null → IAE |
